about: This is a precursor to my other game 'Lizard Lady vs the Cats' with AI and graphics which are simpler. Anyone who has played the other game will be able to see how the AI of the main enemies has been expanded from the AI in this one. There is no story. Just shoot all the enemies and get to the exit.
